extension.summary: Synchronize add-ons and add-on data between Kodi installations
Addons und Addon-Daten zwischen Kodi-Installationen synchronisieren
extension.description: Modernized AddonSync service for Kodi 19+ with selectable synchronization of add-on data, installed add-ons, config, playlists and profiles, Kodi VFS network support and verified SHA-256 manifests.

Modernisierte AddonSync-Version für Kodi 19+ mit auswählbarer Synchronisierung von Addon-Daten, installierten Addons, Config, Playlists und Profilen, Kodi-VFS-Netzwerkzugriff und verifizierten SHA-256-Manifesten.
extension.news:
v102.2.0 - Added selectable Config, Playlists and Profiles synchronization scopes - Config synchronizes portable Kodi master-profile configuration without databases/caches - Profiles synchronizes profiles.xml plus the profiles directory - Manifest schema 4 adds verified whole-folder scopes with rollback on Client updates
v102.1.1 - Added native Kodi background progress notifications during synchronization - Shows current synchronization scope, add-on progress and final update/current/skipped counts - Added a setting to enable or disable synchronization status notifications
v102.1.0 - Added selectable synchronization folders for addon_data and installed add-on files - Added Master-to-Client copying of user-installed add-ons from special://home/addons - Added manifest schema 3 with separate addon_data/addons scopes - Added compatibility reading for 102.0.x manifests and legacy hashdata.xml stores - Add-on code changes now recommend restarting Kodi
v102.0.2 - Pointed add-on source and support metadata to the ICU83 maintained fork - Updated maintainer attribution for the modernized 102.x line
v102.0.1 - Fixed Kodi settings-dialog localization / blank labels - Normalized language PO files and added en_US fallback
v102.0.0 - Reworked service/manual entry points for Python 3 - Replaced broken copy and hash logic - Added VFS-safe recursive hashing and copying for local/SMB/NFS paths - Added JSON SHA-256 manifest with legacy hashdata.xml fallback - Added verified temporary copies before replacing client settings - Fixed manual sync and filter actions - Preserved existing AddonSync setting IDs for in-place upgrades
